subproblem.title: Monotonicity of e^{Λρ}ρ^{−n}μ(B_ρ(y)) with one constant Λ for all members of 𝓜 (property (5); conditional on (IM), (MON), (MB))
subproblem.statement: Assume (IM) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency im_mass_measure, which is the selected node's first leading hypothesis: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every IMRep R of T in U: (a) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W ⊆ U; (b) for x ∈ U, x ∈ spt T if and only if R.measure(B_ε(x)) ≠ 0 for every ε > 0; (c) R′.measure = R.measure for every IMRep R′ of T in U. Assume (MON) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency monotonicity (the selected node's second leading hypothesis): for all P, n, d ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n ≤ d ≤ P, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold N with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅ and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0: (i) for every compact K ⊆ U there is Λ ≥ 0 such that ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is monotone on (0, R) whenever B̄_R(y) ⊆ K; (ii) if N = ℝ^P, then ρ ↦ ofReal(1/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is monotone on (0, R) whenever B_R(y) ⊆ U; (iii) there is Θ, upper semicontinuous on U, with HasMassDensity T y (Θ y) for all y ∈ U; (iv) every density of T at a point of spt T is ≥ 1. Assume (MB) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency moving_blowups (the selected node's third leading hypothesis): for all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k, U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with 1 ≤ n, U open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold, (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T minimizing in U ∩ N, spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U, and for all x ∈ U, x_j → x and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) such that blowUp T x_{φ(j)} λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly), MassMeasuresConverge holds for the same sequence, C is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} and ∂C = 0. Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and 1 ≤ n, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B̄_{2r}(z) ⊆ U, and let RT be an IMRep of T in U; write μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z) and η_{a,t} := dilation a t (η_{a,t}(v) = t⁻¹(v − a)). Let 𝓜 be a set of measures on ℝ^{n+k} such that μ ∈ 𝓜 if and only if either (PS) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map η_{a,t} for some a ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and some t with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t; or (ZS) μ = RS.measure for some S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and some IMRep RS of S in ℝ^{n+k} for which there are points c_i, scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) and a point b with dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, and blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly). (These are the selected node's positive-scale members μ_{x,λ} and zero-scale members, with (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ), c_i = z + rx_i, t_i = rλ_i, b = z + rx̄.) Then there is Λ ∈ ℝ such that for every μ ∈ 𝓜, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every R ∈ ℝ with B̄_R(y) ⊆ B̄_2(0), the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y)) is monotone (nondecreasing) on the open interval (0, R).

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 6 of the selected node's supplied proof (parent 2(a), 2(b)) with Λ := rΛ_K as in its (0c); Simon 7.3.3, proof of (1), uses the monotonicity 4.7 of Ch. 4 for the members of 𝒯 (chapter-07.txt lines 474–483). Positive-scale members are written (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ). Siblings used: zero_limit_minimizing (Submission.dimred_tr_bc_zero_limit_minimizing, with (MB)) and ambient_calculus (Submission.idtp_fons_cc_ambient_calculus) parts (1), (2), (3).
Notation: μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z), K := B̄_{2r}(z), E := ℝ^{n+k}.
1. (Choice of Λ.) K is compact (isCompact_closedBall) and K ⊆ U. Apply (MON) to T with d := n + ℓ (1 ≤ n ≤ n + ℓ ≤ n + k; the other hypotheses are those of T) and part (i) to K: there is Λ_K ≥ 0 such that, whenever B̄_{R′}(c′) ⊆ K, the map τ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λ_Kτ}/τⁿ)·M_{B_τ(c′)}(T) is monotone on (0, R′). Put Λ := rΛ_K ≥ 0.
2. (Products.) If g : ℝ → [0, ∞] is monotone on (0, R) and κ ≥ 0, then ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{κρ})·g(ρ) is monotone on (0, R): both factors are nonnegative and monotone there (mul_le_mul'). For real κ₁, κ₂ and ρ > 0, ofReal(e^{(κ₁+κ₂)ρ}/ρⁿ) = ofReal(e^{κ₁ρ})·ofReal(e^{κ₂ρ}/ρⁿ) (Real.exp_add, ENNReal.ofReal_mul).
3. Let μ ∈ 𝓜, y ∈ E and R ∈ ℝ with B̄_R(y) ⊆ B̄_2(0). If R ≤ 0, then (0, R) = ∅ and there is nothing to prove; assume R > 0. Then ‖y‖ + R ≤ 2: since n + k ≥ 1, there is a unit vector u with y = ‖y‖u (u := ‖y‖⁻¹y if y ≠ 0, any unit vector otherwise); the point y + Ru lies in B̄_R(y) ⊆ B̄_2(0) and has norm ‖y‖ + R.
4. (Case PS.) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map(dilation a t) with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t. Put c′ := a + t•y.
 (a) dist(c′, z) + tR ≤ dist(a, z) + t‖y‖ + tR ≤ (r − t) + t(‖y‖ + R) ≤ r − t + 2t = r + t ≤ 2r. Hence B̄_{tR}(c′) ⊆ K, and for 0 < ρ < R, B_{tρ}(c′) ⊆ W ⊆ U (if dist(v, c′) < tρ then dist(v, z) < tR + dist(c′, z) ≤ 2r).
 (b) For 0 < ρ < R: μ(B_ρ(y)) = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ)·(μ_T⌞W)((dilation a t)⁻¹(B_ρ(y))) (ambient_calculus (2)) = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ)·(μ_T⌞W)(B_{tρ}(c′)) (ambient_calculus (3)) = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ)·μ_T(B_{tρ}(c′)) (Measure.restrict_apply and B_{tρ}(c′) ⊆ W) = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ)·M_{B_{tρ}(c′)}(T) ((IM)(a) for T: U open, RT represents T, B_{tρ}(c′) open and ⊆ U).
 (c) Hence, for 0 < ρ < R, G(ρ) := ofReal(e^{tΛ_Kρ}/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y)) = ofReal(e^{Λ_K(tρ)}/(tρ)ⁿ)·M_{B_{tρ}(c′)}(T), since ofReal(e^{tΛ_Kρ}/ρⁿ)·ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) = ofReal(e^{Λ_K(tρ)}/(tρ)ⁿ) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, (tρ)ⁿ = tⁿρⁿ). By step 1 with (c′, R′ := tR) and (a), the right side is a monotone function of τ = tρ on (0, tR); as ρ ↦ tρ is increasing and maps (0, R) into (0, tR), G is monotone on (0, R).
 (d) By step 2 with κ₁ := (r − t)Λ_K ≥ 0 and κ₂ := tΛ_K, ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y)) = ofReal(e^{(r−t)Λ_Kρ})·G(ρ), which is monotone on (0, R).
5. (Case ZS.) μ = RS.measure for an IMRep RS of S in E with zero-scale data (c_i, t_i, b). Then dist(b, z) ≤ r (limit of dist(c_i, z) < r), so b ∈ U, and zero_limit_minimizing (with (MB), the hypotheses of T and x := b) shows that S is minimizing in E with ∂S = 0. Apply (MON) to S with P := n + k, d := n + k and U = N = univ: IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + k) univ by ambient_calculus (1), (closure univ ∖ univ) ∩ univ = ∅, S is minimizing in univ ∩ univ = univ, spt S ⊆ univ ∩ univ, and ∂S = 0. Part (ii) (N = univ, B_R(y) ⊆ univ) shows that ρ ↦ ofReal(1/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(S) is monotone on (0, R). By (IM)(a) for S (univ open, RS represents S), M_{B_ρ(y)}(S) = RS.measure(B_ρ(y)) = μ(B_ρ(y)). Since ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y)) = ofReal(e^{Λρ})·(ofReal(1/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y))) and Λ ≥ 0, step 2 gives monotonicity on (0, R).
6. Steps 4 and 5 prove the claim with the single constant Λ = rΛ_K of step 1. ∎
proof_key_steps: (MON)(i) for T on the compact K = B̄_{2r}(z) gives Λ_K ≥ 0; take Λ := rΛ_K.

Positive scale (a, t): μ(B_ρ(y)) = t^{−n}M_{B_{tρ}(a+ty)}(T) with B̄_{tR}(a + ty) ⊆ K (since ‖y‖ + R ≤ 2), so e^{tΛ_Kρ}ρ^{−n}μ(B_ρ(y)) is the (MON)(i) quantity at τ = tρ; the extra factor e^{(r−t)Λ_Kρ} is nondecreasing.
Zero scale: S is minimizing with ∂S = 0 (zero_limit_minimizing), so (MON)(ii) on ℝ^{n+k} and (IM)(a) give monotonicity of ρ^{−n}μ(B_ρ(y)); multiply by e^{Λρ}.

audit.reason: The single choice Λ = rΛ_K works in both cases. The proof handles empty intervals, uses n+k ≥ 1 correctly for the ball-containment estimate, and justifies the nondecreasing exponential factors.
